title: Forward proper ordered projection square with a source coefficient comparison
statement: For a cartesian square of proper compactifiable scheme morphisms q and qprime, with qprime quasi-compact, finite commutative coefficients A, arbitrary source complexes L and Lprime, an isomorphism l:gprime*L ≅ Lprime, and an arbitrary base complex K, the ordered projection of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], followed by inverse proper coincidence, commutes with compact-support exchange. The source comparison is tensor pullback followed by tensoring with E = g*(coincidence_q inverse); Ex_! at L; Rqprime_!(l); coincidence_qprime. The target comparison is tensor pullback, the inverse-image square comparison, and l. Precisely the equality in the attached Lean statement holds. No trace, projective-line presentation, exponent, splitting or exceptional adjunction is assumed.

proof.text: Use the proved compactProjectionMapCoeffFirst_baseChangeMap of [lem-asd-compact-projection-exchange]. Naturality of the compact projection in its source coefficient appends l; naturality of tensor pullback moves inverse proper coincidence to the source.

The upstream compactification projection/forget-supports identity identifies the proper compact projection with the ordinary projection: use rightDerivedLowerShriekToLowerStarComp_comp_eq to express the proper coincidence hom through the chosen compactification, then apply projectionMapOfCompactification_comp_compactificationForgetSupports. Conjugate by tensor symmetries, using naturality of proper coincidence and of symmetry, and cancel its inverse. The explicit ordered projection and twisted comparison are those of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows].

lean.statement:
theorem properOrderedProjection_exchange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} {q : X ⟶ Y} {q' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (sq : IsPullback g' q' q g)
    [IsProper q] [IsProper q'] [HasCompactification q] [HasCompactification q']
    [QuasiCompact q']
    (L : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (L' : DerivedCategoryModule A X')
    (l : (ordinaryFinitePullback A g').obj L ≅ L') (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    let F := ordinaryFinitePullback A g
    let R' := R(q')_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]
    let C := rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q
    let C' := rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q'
    let E := F.map (C.inv.app L) ≫ (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A sq).app L ≫
      R'.map l.hom ≫ C'.hom.app L'
    let c := ordinaryFiniteTwistedPullbackComparison A q q' g g' L L' K
      ((derivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq.toCommSq).symm.app K) l
    F.map (ordinaryFiniteProjection A q L K ≫
        C.inv.app ((ordinaryFiniteTwistedPullback A q L).obj K)) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A sq).app
        ((ordinaryFiniteTwistedPullback A q L).obj K) ≫ R'.map c.hom =
    (ordinaryFiniteTensorPullback A g K ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A q).obj L)).hom ≫
      ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A Y').obj (F.obj K)).map E ≫
      ordinaryFiniteProjection A q' L' (F.obj K) ≫
      C'.inv.app ((ordinaryFiniteTwistedPullback A q' L').obj (F.obj K))
